vv36:1.1: Pītavatthe pītadhaje pītālaṅkārabhūsite pītantarāhi vaggūhi apilandhā va sobhasi. || ||
vv36:3.1: Sovaṇṇamayā lohitaṅkamayā muttāmayā veḷuriyāmayā ca masāragallā sahalohitaṅkā pārevatakkhīhi maṇīhi cittatā. || ||
vv36:4.1: Koci koci ettha mayūrasussaro haṃsassar' añño karavīkasussaro tesaṃ saro suyyati vaggurūpo pañcaṅgikaṃ turiyam iva ppavāditaṃ. || ||
vv36:5.1: Ratho ca te subho vaggu nānāratanacittito nānāvaṇṇāhi dhātūhi suvibhatto va sobhati. || ||
vv36:6.1: Tasmiṃ rathe kañcanabimbavaṇṇe yā tvaṃ ṭhitā bhāsas' imaṃ padesaṃ devate pucchitācikkha kissa kammass' idaṃ phalan ti. || ||
vv36:7.1: Sovaṇṇajālaṃ maṇisoṇṇacittaṃ muttācitaṃ hemajālena channaṃ parinibbute Gotame appameyye pasannacittā aham ābhiropayiṃ. || ||
vv36:8.1: Tāhaṃ kammaṃ karitvāna kusalaṃ buddhavaṇṇitaṃ apetasokā sukhitā sampamodām' anāmayā ti. || ||
